name: Anker 321 Power Bank (PowerCore 5K), model A1112
author: catalogue (outline modelled in assemblies/froggy_v8.py:_bank_solid from the published dimensions)

dimensions_mm.source: Micro Center listing 3.78 x 1.78 x 0.91 in (96.01 x 45.21 x 23.11 mm); edge radii modelled (R5 long edges, R1.5 ends)

capacity.note: 5200 mAh is Anker's total nominal cell capacity; Wh = 5.2 Ah x 3.7 V

ports.usb_c: input and output, 5 V 2.4 A (12 W)

low_current_auto_off: Not published by Anker. Anker banks typically cut off below roughly 50 to 100 mA (unverified). The A1112 has a trickle-charging mode for low-power devices (double-press the button).
use_on_rotor: USB-A out -> KCD1 rocker in the 5 V lead -> Pi micro-USB; USB-C is the charge input from v_charge_port
